## Summary

The Hosting ABI is thin and observational (N2): it negotiates `hh-hosting/1`,
drives the closed verb vocabulary, lifts session-ABI records into native
ledger rows with explicit stamps, probes conformance, and refuses —
typed, never silent — what it cannot vouch for.

**`hh-hosting` (new tier crate).** `abi.rs` carries the `hh-hosting/1`
handshake (`negotiate`: highest mutual major; nothing advertised → v1 with
every declaration `unknown`; unknown major → `AbiVersionUnsupported`), the
closed baseline/capability-declared/excluded verb sets, and `UnknownVerb`.
`service.rs` drives sessions (open/submit/cancel/resume/close/stream) with
policy-first ordering, credential-channel validation against the participant
declaration, placement checks, capability-vector gates, dense event
sequence enforcement, and synthesized unobserved terminals.
`adapter_a.rs` is the records-in/records-out session-ABI transport;
`fixture.rs` is the in-process scripted participant; `probes.rs` is the
P-01…P-16 catalogue with the six P0 dimensions; `budget.rs` derives
`budget_enforcement` per mechanism×placement (Lab/adapter-derived, never
participant-declared).

**Provenance vouching (DF-S1.3-2, closed).**
`MintingContext.vouched_participants` lets `default_authority_in` mint
`delegate` for participant-origin content the attach path explicitly
vouched; unvouched stays `unverified`; participant origins can never
endorse. Audit-grade/kernel-origin rows stay kernel-minted — participant
reports ride payload markers (`participant_reported`, `synthesized`,
`mediation`) the metric folds read.

**Registry + ledger.** `lifecycle.registry.quarantined` class,
`RegistryStore::quarantine`, and `reconcile_capability_vector` over
`ConformanceRecord.hosted_entries` — latest non-stale record per
dimension, declaration fallback, stale annotates never hides. P0 drift
quarantines the participant version; non-P0 drift annotates.

**Embed + CLI (`R-2.11.1²`).** `lab.hosting.{describe,probe,attach}` are
registered ops over a JSON `HostingPlane` seam — no base-crate dep on
`hh-hosting` (removable, CC6). Attach validates participant ref +
credential channels + ABI negotiation, requires the writer/session lease,
is idempotent on the attach pair, and mints `lifecycle.hosted.attached`,
`lifecycle.component.bound{hosting_adapter}`, `hosted.native_record`,
`hosted.drift_observed`, and the dual measured/participant-reported cost
rows. `hh participant {describe,probe,register,conformance}` forwards
through the generated client only.

**Experiment engine (`R-2.10.3²`).** Hosted arms route through
`HostedLauncher` before the subject run opens — absent/refusing launcher
fails closed (`HostedLaunchUnavailable`, budget slice returned, never a
silent native downgrade). `HostedLaunchOutcome` stamps mechanism,
`session_ref`, `limits_enforced` (adapter-derived; `full` claims refused
as unverifiable), `adapter_version_id`,
`participant_version_identity`, `abi_version`, `capability_vector`,
`budget_enforcement`, `observability_level`, `mediation`.

**Hosted metrics.** Seven folds over native `FactRow`s: hosted
applicability, mediation coverage, observation completeness, duplicate
action rate, blast radius, usage-report agreement (symmetric — omission
counts as disagreement), conformance-drift count, synthesized-terminal
rate.

**Hosted desugaring (`R-2.10.1²`).** `hosted.parameters`/`hosted.values`
now populate the assembly — `hosted_scaffold` returns them as a
synthesized `hosted:scaffold` `PackagedDefault` layer below the authored
layers; stage 3 enforces `affects ⊆ {configuration, product}` and
`sweepable` only over capability coordinates the declaration records
`supported` — the new `C-PARAM-6 InadmissibleHostedParameter` diagnostic
(the dialect-bump fixture this ticket owns; ADR-0013 (4), ADR-0296 D6).

## Acceptance criteria evidence

- **AC-R-2.10.6-1** (join through `hh-hosting/1`, class-aware `n/a`,
  `InadmissibleFactor` on component-level): `hh-embed/tests/hosting.rs`
  (describe/attach suites), `hosted_root_na_rows_and_class6` +
  `hosted_parameter_space_populates_and_gates`
  (`hh-lab/tests/assembly_service.rs`), hosted engine tests
  (`hh-experiment/tests/engine.rs`).
- **AC-3** (probe → entries → reconcile → P0 quarantine; non-P0 annotates):
  `hosting_probe_registers_entries_and_reconciles`,
  `hosting_probe_p0_drift_quarantines`,
  `hosting_probe_non_p0_drift_annotates_without_quarantine`,
  `hosting_probe_drive_*` (plane-absent refusal + plane-driven records).
- **AC-4** (policy-first): service credential/placement/permission gates +
  `policy_deny` P0 probe.
- **AC-7** (credential channels only): attach validates
  `credential_supply`; secrets never reach a ledger (`provided: yes/no`).
- **AC-8** (adapter debt): `AdapterRecord` debt completeness checked at
  attach.
- **AC-9** (dual cost rows + symmetric agreement):
  `hosting_attach_dual_cost_rows_fold_usage_agreement`.
- **AC-10** (ABI version negotiation): `hh_hosting::abi::negotiate` +
  attach-version stamps.
- **Removability:** `scripts/check-removability.sh` — hosting tier absent
  leaves the base suite unchanged (`hosting_edges = []`; `hh-cli`/`hh-embed`
  carry no normal dep on `hh-hosting`).

- **Stale-binary footgun:** `hh-cli` `in_process` tests reuse
  `target/debug/hh-kernel` when present — after schema-changing tickets,
  rebuild `cargo build -p hh-kernel` before running them or `hello`
